Hi, {open_msgs} messages are waiting for {brand}. Some need a decision from you. Can you look today?
Hi, your community report is ready: {pub90} posts in 90 days, average first reply {avg_reply} minutes, rating {rating}. Shall we talk about it?
Hi, {unrev} reviews for {brand} are waiting for a reply and the rating is {rating}. Do you want to approve our replies?
Hi, the {format} "{topic}" for {platform} goes live on {date} ({days} days) and its status is {status}. Please approve it for {brand}.
Hi, for the post "{topic}" on {date} we still need the photo or video. Can you send it today?
Hi, our post on {platform} on {date} for {brand} was {state}. Reason: {reason}. We have changed our routine to stop it happening again.
Hi, we want to confirm the posting hour for {platform}: it was planned at {hour} hours. Is that still right for {brand}?
Hi, a {kind} on {platform} says: "{text}". It is {state}. How would you like us to answer for {brand}?
Hi, the {kind} from {date} on {platform} was answered in {reply_min} minutes, above our target. We are tightening the rota for {brand}.
Hi, a customer left {stars} stars on {source} for {brand}: "{comment}". We suggest a calm public reply. Do you agree?
Hi, a lovely review for {brand}: {stars} stars on {source}: "{comment}". Can we share it as a post?
Hi, the {stars} star review from {date} on {source} has no reply yet. Shall we answer it for {brand}?
Hi, urgent: {topic} on {platform} for {brand}. Severity is {level} (score {score}). We pause scheduled posts. Please call us.
Hi, the holding statement for "{topic}" is ready. Please approve it so we can answer publicly today.
Hi, the case "{topic}" for {brand} is {state} after {days_open} days. We will send a short summary this week.
Hi, the {name} for {brand} runs from {start} to {end}. The prize costs {prize}. Please approve the rules.
Hi, the winner of the {name} is entry number {winner_no} out of {entries}. Shall we announce it today?
Hi, the {name} brought {new_followers} new followers from {entries} entries at {cpf} a follower. Shall we run another?
Hi, we asked {handle} for permission to reuse their {kind} for {brand}. The status is {state}. We will post it once it is cleared.
Hi, the licence for the {kind} from {handle} ends on {expires}, in {days_left} days. Shall we renew it or take the post down?
Hi, the licence for the {kind} from {handle} on {platform} has ended. We suggest we remove it from {brand}. Do you agree?
Hi, the live "{title}" for {brand} is on {date} on {platform}, {planned} minutes. Please confirm the topic and who joins.
Hi, the live "{title}" reached {peak} viewers at its peak, with {comments} comments and {new_followers} new followers. Shall we plan the next one?
Hi, the group "{name}" for {brand} is {state} with {members} members ({growth} change). Rules were last checked {rules_age} days ago. Shall we refresh them?
Hi, to grow "{name}" we plan {posts_week} posts a week. Can you send a question or offer for the members?
Hi, we passed this case to {to}: {topic}. Urgency {urgency}, due by {due}. We will keep {brand} informed.
Hi, the mood around {brand} in the week of {week} is {state} (net score {score}, {neg} negative messages). Can we talk about it?
Hi, brand safety alert for {brand} on {platform}: {kind}. Level {level}. Please do not share logins and wait for our update.
Hi {name}, in {month} you own {msgs} messages and {mods} moderation actions, about {need} hours for {hours_month} planned. Let us talk about the load.
Hi {name}, you have {left} spare community hours in {month}. Can you help with the inbox this week?
Crisis holding statement to the client
Crisis note for {col:crisis.brand}, issued by {set:firm} on {today}.

On {col:crisis.date} we saw this on {col:crisis.platform}: {col:crisis.topic}. We scored it {col:crisis.score} for reach, impact and speed, which is a {col:crisis.level} level case owned by {col:crisis.owner}.
The case has been open for {col:crisis.days_open} days and its status is {col:crisis.state}. Until you tell us otherwise we will not delete comments and we will not argue in public.
Please approve the holding statement and tell us who speaks for your brand if the press calls.
Official rules of the {col:giveaways.name} by {col:giveaways.brand}, run on {col:giveaways.platform} by {set:firm}.
The giveaway runs from {col:giveaways.start} to {col:giveaways.end}, which is {col:giveaways.days} days. The prize is worth {col:giveaways.prize}.
The winner is drawn by number from all valid entries and is announced on the same platform. The winner has seven days to answer before another winner is drawn.
This giveaway is not run, endorsed or paid for by the social platform. Entrants must follow the platform rules and the laws of their country.
Permission request from {col:ugc.brand}, sent by {set:firm} on {today}.
We love your {col:ugc.kind} on {col:ugc.platform} ({col:ugc.handle}), posted on {col:ugc.date}. We would like to share it on the brand channels and we will always credit you.
We ask for a licence of {col:ugc.months} months. You can ask us to remove it at any time. Permission status today: {col:ugc.permission}.
Please answer yes or no. We will not use your content without your clear answer.
Review reply for the client to approve
Review reply proposed by {set:firm} for {col:reviews.brand}, dated {today}.
A customer left {col:reviews.stars} stars on {col:reviews.date} on {col:reviews.source}: "{col:reviews.comment}".
The review level is {col:reviews.level} and the reply status is {col:reviews.state}. Our target is to answer within {set:rev_days} days.
Please approve the reply we send, or tell us what you would add.
Live session brief for the team
Live session brief: {col:lives.title} for {col:lives.brand}, issued by {set:firm} on {today}.
The live is on {col:lives.date} on {col:lives.platform}, planned for {col:lives.planned} minutes and hosted by {col:lives.host}.
Past lives of this kind reached a peak of {col:lives.peak} viewers. Book a moderator, test sound and light one hour before and prepare the questions to ask.
After the live, post the clip within two days and answer the comments within a day.
Monthly community report to the client
Community report for {col:clients.brand}, prepared by {set:firm} on {today}.
In the last 90 days we published {col:clients.pub90} posts. Today {col:clients.queued} posts wait in the queue and {col:clients.late90} posts were late or missed.
Your average first reply takes {col:clients.avg_reply} minutes, {col:clients.open_msgs} messages are waiting and the average rating of the last six months is {col:clients.rating}.
Community health today: {col:clients.health}. We will talk about what to improve at our next meeting.
Moderation rules for {col:clients.brand}, agreed with {set:firm} on {today}.
We hide or delete spam, scam links, personal data and abuse. We answer questions and complaints within {set:resp_target} minutes in working hours and never argue in public.
Serious cases go to {col:clients.manager} at once and your phone number is used for urgent news. Today {col:clients.open_msgs} messages are waiting.
The client accepts these rules by signing below.
{col:esc.source} passes this case to {col:esc.to}: {col:esc.topic}. Urgency is {col:esc.urgency} and the case is due by {col:esc.due}.
The case has been open for {col:esc.days_open} days and its status is {col:esc.state}. Please confirm that you accept it and tell the client what happens next.
Close the case in the log with the date of the answer.
Brand safety notice for {col:safety.brand}, issued by {set:firm} on {today}.
On {col:safety.date} we found this on {col:safety.platform}: {col:safety.kind}. We rate it {col:safety.level} (severity {col:safety.severity} of 5) and {col:safety.owner} owns the case.
The case has been open for {col:safety.days_open} days and its status is {col:safety.state}. We will tell you when it is solved.
Please change shared logins if the notice speaks of access and tell us if you saw anything else.

We have changed our routine so that it does not happen again. {col:late.owner} checks the queue every morning.
We are sorry for the trouble and will gladly talk about it.

Open Start and type your agency name and your own rules in the yellow cells: target minutes to reply, minutes a post may be late, days allowed for a review, the crisis score limits and the highest cost per giveaway follower.
Fill Brand Clients: one row for each brand. Posts published, messages waiting, average reply time, rating and the community health check fill in from the other sheets.
Record every post that goes live on Publishing Log with its reach, likes, comments, shares and saves. The engagement and the engagement rate are worked out by themselves.
Keep Scheduled Queue up to date. The flag shows which posts are blocked by approval, media or a broken link and which are due in the next days.
Write each late or missed post on Late or Missed Posts with the reason. Leave the minutes empty for a post that never went out.
Put comments and messages on Community Inbox. Leave the reply minutes empty until you answer, and the sheet shows what is waiting or overdue against your target.
Use Response Times, Sentiment by Week and Reviews and Ratings to see how fast you answer, how people feel and what they rate you, then use Mentions and Tags to thank and reuse good posts.
Score every crisis on Crisis Log from 1 to 5 for reach, impact and speed. Use Escalations and Brand Safety for cases that need a senior person.
Keep ready replies on Saved Replies and the most asked questions on Common Questions. Review the ones marked due.
Plan each giveaway on Giveaways and record entries and new followers when it ends. Draw winners by number with the Winner Picker.
Record permission for each customer photo or video on UGC Rights. The sheet warns before a licence ends.
Use Live Sessions, Community Groups and Moderation Actions to track lives, group growth and the time spent keeping the community safe.
Watch Community Team to see the hours each person needs for messages and moderation before you promise faster replies.

Use the 14 calculators for reply targets, inbox workload, winner picking, crisis score, reply finding, best day, rating trend, giveaway cost, moderation load, live planning, sentiment, group growth, content licences and escalations.
Print 10 sheets and 10 letters, follow 10 step-by-step checklists and tap a message link to open WhatsApp with the text ready.
Read Community Dashboard and Charts every week: messages waiting, reply speed, late posts, reviews to answer, open crises and licences ending.
